scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "yarn --cwd backend dev" "yarn --cwd frontend watch"
scripts.dev:split: npx concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "yarn --cwd backend dev" "yarn --cwd frontend dev"
scripts.build: yarn --cwd frontend build && yarn --cwd backend build
scripts.lint: yarn --cwd backend lint && yarn --cwd frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: yarn --cwd frontend build --noEmit 2>/dev/null || yarn --cwd frontend tsc --noEmit
